title: Cloud Billing adds Agent Messaging and Task Management
summary: The Cloud Billing API has introduced a new interaction model involving 'agents' and 'tasks', while enforcing stricter requirements on existing parameters.
details: This update introduces significant new resources: `message` and `tasks`. Developers can now use `message.send` for blocking requests to a billing agent and `message.stream` for real-time updates. Accompanying these are task management methods including `tasks.get`, `tasks.cancel`, and `tasks.subscribe` for monitoring long-running operations. Crucially, this is a breaking change: the `name` and `parent` parameters have been promoted to strictly required across several methods. If your existing integrations omitted these fields, they will now fail. Additionally, `tasks.get` now supports a `historyLength` parameter and an experimental `tenant` parameter for multi-tenant environments.
